mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS chunkId, c.file_id AS fileId, f.original_name AS fileName, c.page_no AS pageNo, c.chunk_index AS chunkIndex, c.content AS content, MATCH(c.content) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN BOOLEAN MODE) AS score, 0 AS `rank` FROM kb_chunk c LEFT JOIN kb_file f ON c.file_id = f.id WHERE MATCH(c.content) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN BOOLEAN MODE) ORDER BY score DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT #{topk}

SELECT c.id AS chunkId, c.file_id AS fileId, f.original_name AS fileName, c.page_no AS pageNo, c.chunk_index AS chunkIndex, c.content AS content, 0 AS score, 0 AS `rank` FROM kb_chunk c LEFT JOIN kb_file f ON c.file_id = f.id WHERE c.file_id = #{fileId} AND c.chunk_index BETWEEN #{startChunkIndex} AND #{endChunkIndex} ORDER BY c.chunk_index ASC, c.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
